remarks: Playhouse Condominium is adjoining to Westport County Playhouse and conveniently located in downtown. Livingroom has cathedral ceiling and a fireplace. The kitchen has newer stainless steel appliances and adjoins the dining area. A bedroom on the first floor maybe used as an office. Second floor master bedroom has sliders to a private deck, a walk-in closet and a regular closet as well and well sized master bath. Two dedicated parking spaces in the parking garage. Walking distance to restaurants, shopping, library and post office. Short drive to Metro North train station. Agent is part owner. Tenant should get a renter liability insurance for no less than $500,000. No pets allowed per the Association. Tenant must obey the rules and regulations, the bylaws and declaration of the complex. The rules are attached to the listing. the other documents could be sent to the potential renter upon request.
